gamesRoute.title: Arcade Library
gamesRoute.copy: Choose a game and open a spacious dedicated arena. Your wallet, notifications, and account remain available across the platform.
gamesRoute.offlineCopy: Your scores are saved. Check back soon or return to the live room.
gameUi.activate: Click or tap the game to activate controls.
gameUi.pacInstructions: Arrow keys or WASD move. Swipe on touch. P or Escape pauses.
gameUi.spaceInstructions: Arrow keys or A/D move. Hold Space or Fire to shoot. P or Escape pauses.
gameUi.slitherCopy: Navigate through a glowing arena, consume energy orbs, avoid enemy creatures, and become the longest creature on the server.
gameUi.howToCopy: Arrow keys/WASD steer your creature. Mouse aims it. Hold Space, left mouse, or Boost to accelerate. Mobile players can steer with touch and boost from the joystick controls.
